lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 106310112 · After Garden Room chat 3. Flora!

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Everyone, thank you so much for all your hard work over the past two weeks ✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Without Blossom and the Happy Zoo,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: we never would have been able to protect the garden ✿

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Hehe :3

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: These past two weeks have meant the world to me.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I wish the garden could stay open every day.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Meow!

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Whenever I'm lying down in the garden,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I fall asleep in no time.
You all did a great job.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I also enjoyed the food Trainer bought for us!

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Yeah, thanks for the cat treats, meow.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Thanks, Zoo Keeper!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: That's so nice of you to bring Timi such tasty treats, hehe.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Thank you, Blossom ✿

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I enjoyed learning about all the flowers while working in the garden!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Oh, by the way, Flora.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I noticed there are some delphiniums and freesias in the garden.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Could you remind me again what those flowers stand for?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I memorized the meanings of dahlias and marigolds,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: but I forgot about those two. T_T

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Of course ✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Delphiniums symbolize

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: the desire

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: to make another person happy.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: That'd be the perfect flower for me to give you, Trainer!
Hahaha, I'll just accept the thought.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Delphinium looks like

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: it'd be perfect to use while out hunting, meow.
Steady now, Nero.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: As for freesia,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: it symbolizes the desire for someone

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: to have a new beginning.
These flowers have such beautiful meanings.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I know, right?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Can we visit the garden again sometime,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Flora?

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Of course, you're welcome to visit anytime ✿

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Then, could you tell me more about the flowers in the garden next time?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: While I was walking around, there were a lot of flowers that I was curious about.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Of course ✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: I'll tell you everything you want to know.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: All right, we better leave for now.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: It does get confusing when there are too many group chats T_T

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: This was fun!

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: See you next time, meow.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I had a great time.
Biscuit left the group.
Nero left the group.
Leona left the group.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Aren't you leaving, Blossom?
I'm planning on staying, actually.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Then I'll stay as well.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: This group chat holds plenty of memories worth keeping ✿
